title: Fix Sketchpad Transaction State Management
description: Fix sketchpad state management so that: (1) Every UI interaction is scoped within a transaction and only triggers commands, (2) Every command creates a new diff, (3) After transaction is finalized diffs are squashed and placed in history stack, (4) During a transaction, kitDiffs are NOT applied to real kit data — they are stored in the transaction stack and displayed via squashed preview (designWithDiff). On finalize, the squashed kitDiff is applied once to the real kit and pushed to history. On abort, the transaction stack is cleared with no kit changes needed. (5) Undo/Redo uses the history stack outside of a transaction. For drag: remove the undo() hack + execute(dragUpdate) per tick in onNodeDrag; only call execute(dragUpdate) once on drag stop before finalize. Fix PlainKitDiffAppStore finalizeTransaction to apply squashed kitDiff. Fix abortTransaction, undo, redo within transaction to not apply kitDiff (since it was never applied). Fix DesignStore.executeCommand to skip kitStore.change(result.kitDiff) when transaction is active.
summary:
Fixed sketchpad transaction state management with a clean deferred-kitDiff architecture:

1. **PlainKitDiffAppStore** — added `finalizeTransaction()` override that squashes the transaction stack and applies the squashed `kitDiff` to the real kit only on finalize. This removes the previous approach where each command applied changes immediately.

2. **PlainKitDiffAppStore.abortTransaction** — no longer applies undo kitDiffs on abort since kitDiffs were never applied during the transaction. Only reverts `selectionDiff` changes.

3. **PlainKitDiffAppStore.undo/redo within transaction** — removed kitDiff application since the kit was never mutated during the transaction. Only selection diffs are reversed/forwarded.

4. **DesignStore.executeCommand** — skips `kitStore.change(result.kitDiff)` when a transaction is active. The kitDiff is deferred to `finalizeTransaction`.

5. **onNodeDrag** — removed the per-tick `execute("compose.designApp.dragUpdate", ...)` and `undo()` hack. Visual drag positions are driven solely by `applyDragPreviewPositions`. The transaction stack stays empty during drag.

6. **onNodeDragStop** — removed the `undo()` before the final `execute(dragUpdate)`. Since the kit was not modified during drag, the kit is at the pre-drag state, the inverse is computed correctly, and `finalizeTransaction` applies the single diff to the kit.

This eliminates the illegal internal state where React Flow node positions and real kit data were out of sync during drag. All 2 non-browser playwright tests pass.
